title: The bullwhip effect
caption: A 10% rise in consumer sales becomes a 20% order from the retailer and a 40% order from the wholesaler. Each stage reads the order it receives as demand and adds safety stock, so the swing quadruples by the time it reaches the brewer.
alt: Columns for the retailer, wholesaler and brewer: the demand change each sees (10%, 20%, 40%) and the order each places (20%, 40%, then expanded production).
description: The retailer sees a 10% rise in sales and orders 20% more.
The wholesaler sees a 20% rise and orders 40% more.
The brewer sees a 40% rise and expands production.
A 10% change has become 40% by the brewer.

relations.name: the wholesaler sees the retailer's order as demand
the brewer sees the wholesaler's order as demand
the original 10% swing is four times larger by the brewer
